about: Every plan in energy-plans-au.json that does not come from the government feed. The weekly plans job (tools/fetch-energy-plans.py) reads this file, checks it and copies these plans into the published list; nobody edits the published list itself. Changes need the developer's approval comment on the pull request. Ids must contain a dash; rates are dollars per kWh, 0 to 1.50.

plans.name: Night Saver EV
plans.source: agl.com.au Night Saver EV plan page, checked 8 Aug 2026: 8c/kWh 12am-6am is published and VERIFIED ('Charge for only 8c/kWh between 12 and 6am'). Proven ABSENT from AGL's government CDR feed (all 1,276 plans checked), so day rates are network-dependent indicative estimates - correct against your bill. Needs an EV in the household and a smart meter. 8c does not apply to controlled load.
plans.notes: The 8c midnight to 6 am EV window is AGL's published rate to June 2026 and may change. The daytime rate varies by plan and region, check your bill and edit it here. Requires a digital meter.

plans.name: HomeEV
plans.source: alintaenergy.com.au HomeEV page, checked 8 Aug 2026: 8c/kWh 12am-6am is published and VERIFIED ('just 8c/kWh from 12am to 6am'). Day rates and the official state list are postcode-gated - the day figure here is an indicative estimate, correct against your bill. Proof of EV ownership and a smart meter required; reasonable use policy applies to the 8c window.

plans.name: EV Power Up (scheduled charging add-on)
plans.source: originenergy.com.au/ev-power-up, checked 8 Aug 2026: 8c/kWh for scheduled EV charging is published and VERIFIED. IMPORTANT: this is an add-on with no clock window - Origin's app schedules the charging and credits those kWh back to 8c; instant/override charging bills at your underlying plan's rates. Model your scheduled charges with this plan and everything else with your base plan. Needs a compatible EV or smart charger (Tesla, BYD, others), a smart meter, and the Origin app.

plans.name: Red EV Saver
plans.source: redenergy.com.au EV Saver T&C (24 Jun 2025) + Energy Made Easy RED552839MRE, checked 8 Aug 2026: free usage 12pm-2pm Sat+Sun is published and VERIFIED. All other times are a flat anytime rate that varies by network and is only shown at postcode quote - the flat figure here is an indicative estimate, correct it against your bill. Needs a smart meter and an EV registered in your name. No lock-in.

plans.name: Solar Sharer Offer
plans.source: redenergy.com.au/solar-sharer-offer, checked 8 Aug 2026: the free daily window (capped 24 kWh/day) is published and VERIFIED. Rates outside the free window are postcode-quoted and may run higher than a standard flat plan - the flat figure here is an indicative estimate, correct it against your bill. Smart meter required; QLD is South East Queensland only.

plans.name: Amber - Wholesale Passthrough
plans.source: Amber passes through the NEM wholesale spot price, which changes every 30 minutes and can spike or go negative — no fixed rate exists. The 25c here is a placeholder: EDIT it to your typical charging-time rate from the Amber app, or enter the actual rate on each charge. True dynamic pricing support is planned.

plans.name: Night Saver EV
plans.source: Full rate card VERIFIED from a NSW customer's AGL app (Ausgrid area, 9 Aug 2026): EV Night 8c 12am-6am, Off Peak 28.82c, Shoulder 20.52c 10am-2pm, Peak 43.62c 3pm-9pm, all inc GST. Supply 87.16c/day, solar FiT 4c ex GST. Night Saver EV overlays YOUR network's TOU windows, so times and day rates differ outside Ausgrid - check your bill and correct here. 8c window is AGL-published, absent from the CDR feed.

plans.source: Customer bill, Dec 2025 (Endeavour zone)
